## Four passes

1. Inspected the frozen observer/common scope and confirmed file URL resolution
   prevents valid root-relative static assets. Read only the specified protocol,
   never operator/variant mappings or other model results.
2. Built a separate derivative with its entire measurement block unchanged. Added
   immutable copied/snapshotted artifacts, a port-0 loopback GET/HEAD-only static
   server and external-request confinement. No code paths forward network traffic.
3. Five focused controls pass using the actual installed Chromium. Relative and
   root-relative assets produce identical measured views and screenshot hashes;
   CSS and JavaScript actually run. Unsafe methods, traversal, malformed encodings,
   wrong hosts, missing files and symlinks reject. Fetch, worker fetch and WebSocket
   attempts never contact an independent sentinel. Failed browser launch retains
   failure evidence and unchanged source hashes. Exact measurement-code bytes are
   compared with the frozen observer. Test-owned temporary files/processes are
   cleaned up; reproducible failure cases and actual result log remain retained.
4. Froze the plan, verified all bindings, and ran only the authorized opaque demo.
   Inspected actual wide/narrow PNGs. Source/copy before/after manifests agree.
   Final runnable gate executes controls and verifies the frozen protocol. Parent
   review and full supplementary collection remain outstanding.
